title: Compilation of expressions
statement: For an expression and a natural-number temporary-register index $k$, compile a constant $n$ by applying the digit-list code at address $-(23+4k)$ to the base-$2$ digits of $n$. Compile a variable $x$ by subtracting the pool address $-(25+8x)$ from the frame-pointer register address $-11$ and storing the result at address $-13$, then loading into address $-(23+4k)$ from the memory address held there. For an operation applied to expressions $a$ and $b$, concatenate their compilations at indices $k$ and $k+1$, then apply the operation to the registers at addresses $-(23+4k)$ and $-(23+4(k+1))$, storing the result at the first address; for a load applied to $a$, append to its compilation at index $k$ the instruction that loads into that register from the memory address held in it.
hypotheses_covered: An expression in the language of constants, variables, binary operations, and loads
